title: Line too long error when building dev_build=yes from sources with spine-godot
body:
### Tested versions

Godot: 4.3-stable
Scons: tested with 4.8.0, 4.8.1


### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.3 stable

### Issue description

Originally asked on the forum, but no one answered: https://forum.godotengine.org/t/line-too-long-when-compiling-engine-with-spine-godot-on-windows/92348
Also mentioned in the comment: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/95563#issuecomment-2498043526

TLDR: I followed the official [guidelines](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/contributing/development/configuring_an_ide/visual_studio.html) for MSVS, but MSVS can't build the project with spine-godot.

I will test and update whether I can build it from command-line with scons directly (I used to be able to do that recently)
